en.1: I feel excited about new places or unknown situations.
en.2: If a reward were guaranteed, I'd take on a challenge with some risk.
en.3: Even at a gathering full of unfamiliar people, I actively start conversations.
en.4: If something looks interesting, I try it even when the outcome is unclear.
en.5: I avoid situations where I might fail and pick the sure path.
en.6: Before starting something new, I research the risks thoroughly.
en.7: In a first-time situation I feel strong anxiety or tension.
en.8: I'd rather avoid situations where the outcome is uncertain.
en.9: When deciding, I trust what feels right more than pure logic.
en.10: I often move to action right away on the spur of the moment.
en.11: I understand things by sensing them with my body first.
en.12: Rather than thinking step by step, I size up the whole at a glance.
en.13: Before deciding, I lay out and compare the pros and cons.
en.14: Before acting, I make a solid plan and the order of steps.
en.15: To reach a conclusion I gather as much information as possible and compare.
en.16: Rather than rush to a decision, I take time to check as I go.
en.17: I enjoy time spent alone in daydreams and imagination.
en.18: I like to look back carefully over my inner self and feelings.
en.19: I spend more time thinking things over in my head than on what's happening.
en.20: I often savour stories or music by connecting them to my own experience.
en.21: I feel more energised when I'm out among people, activity and stimulation.
en.22: Talking with people or meeting outside events often sparks my ideas.
en.23: I feel more at ease or prefer lively places over a quiet room.
en.24: Rather than think it through in my head, I feel most at home handling things or being on site.
en.25: When someone is hurting, I feel a pang in my own chest.
en.26: I'm good at putting myself in another person's shoes.
en.27: I can read how someone is feeling from their face and expression.
en.28: I naturally find myself thinking about how others feel.
en.29: I tend to judge objectively, without being carried away by others' emotions.
en.30: When solving a problem, I put facts and reason ahead of emotion.
en.31: In relationships I don't push the distance closer than is needed.
en.32: I value a person's logical consistency over group empathy.
en.33: I tend to have big ups and downs in mood.
en.34: I'm prone to anxiety or worry over small things.
en.35: When something unpleasant happens, I keep turning it over for a long time.
en.36: I dwell on criticism or failure longer than most people.
en.37: Even under stress, I can calm myself down fairly quickly.
en.38: My emotions are stable and rarely swing violently.
en.39: Even in a difficult situation, I can cope without panicking.
en.40: I take things less personally and bounce back quickly.
en.41: I have never once told a lie.
en.42: I am always completely honest with everyone.
en.44: Even on an off day, I can reliably perform at my usual level.
